name: Komari Ayumi
source: Ayumi is Touki’s senpai and the student council president of Ainoshima Gakuen. Gentle and good at taking care of others, she is the perfect onee-san. Perhaps it is because of her maternal instincts, that she will often accept people's requests for advice. Being very popular among the students, she has both male and female supporters.
